name: How long does it take to install box molding in a living room?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install box molding in a living room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to install box molding in a living room depends on the room's size, the number of boxes, the intricacy of the design, and any necessary wall preparation. For an average-sized living room with a standard box molding pattern, the installation could take anywhere from one to three days. This includes time for precise measurements, cutting, attaching the molding, caulking all seams, and painting. Larger rooms or more elaborate designs will naturally require more time to ensure quality craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing box molding in a living room typically takes one to three days, depending on room size, design complexity, and necessary wall preparation.
